titles.reference: Copy a table to every cluster node
titles.scale: Change the number of cluster nodes

replicaReason: A replica follows this node and takes its place on its own if the node is lost or corrupt. It takes one project slot.
homeReplicaReason: A replica follows the home node and takes its place on its own, on the same address, if the home is lost or corrupt. Without one, a broken home takes the whole cluster down until it is repaired. It takes one project slot.
removeHomeReplicaReason: Without a replica, if the home node is lost or corrupt the whole cluster is unavailable until it is restored from its backups. Its project slot is freed.
removeReplicaReason: Without a replica, if this node is lost or corrupt its share of the data is unavailable until it is restored from its backups. Its project slot is freed.
intro: A cluster spreads a table's rows over several cluster nodes by a column you choose, such as an account id, behind one connection string. Queries that name the column go to one cluster node; the rest are answered across all of them.
enableHint: Each cluster node uses one of your plan's project slots, and you have {spare} free. Making it a cluster keeps the database running (its services move to pods of their own, which can refuse a request for a few seconds), and nothing moves until you add a cluster node.
planUnread: Your plan could not be read just now.
allSlotsUsed: Each cluster node uses one of your plan's project slots, and all {max} are in use.
slotsEachReplica: {slots}. Each cluster node and replica uses one.
failoverFailed: Its replica could not take its place: {error}

joinSteps.copy: Starting as a copy of the home node
joinSteps.share: Taking its share of the data

copyWait: Starting as a copy of the home node ({state}).
scaleDownFirst: Scale down to one cluster node first (this cluster has {nodes}), so every row is on the home node.
checkReadFailed: The design check could not read the tables: {error}
advisorNeeds: Needs {list} before it can be planned.
routerStarting: The router is starting beside the database, which takes about twenty seconds.
routerPaused: The project is paused. The router wakes with it on the next connection.
replicaFull: A replica takes one project slot, and all of your plan's are in use.
addReason: A new node starts as a copy of the home node, then joins the cluster and takes its share of the distributed tables on its own. Writes to a range pause for a moment when it moves. It uses one of your plan's project slots.
tablesEmpty: Every table is on the home node. Distribute one to spread its rows over the cluster nodes.
spreadReason: In one go: a keyspace for the column (shared with tables keyed the same way), the table distributed by it, then its ranges spread over the nodes.

fields.keyHint: A primary key or unique constraint must include it.
fields.typeHint: bigint, int, text, uuid, and the other types the router hashes.
fields.name: Name

checkIntro: Every row lives on the node its distribution key points to. Foreign keys, unique keys and joins work on one node only when they include that key, so this reads the tables, foreign keys and indexes and says what to change.
disableBody: Every row is on the home node, so turning it off moves nothing. The data is checked first, then the router leaves, which restarts the database once.
failoverHeld: Stopped, not replaced: its replica was behind and its last writes could not be copied to it, so nothing was given up. See Alerts.
failoverRunning: This node was lost or damaged. Its replica is taking its place on its own, and queries that need its data may fail for a moment.
splitHint: A hash value inside the range. Empty: the middle.
dropBlocked: A table is distributed by it. Bring it home first.
attachHint: Ready, joining by hand: attach it to give the cluster a node to move a range onto.
letGo: Let go by the cluster; its pod is being deleted.
noJobs: No operations have run on this cluster yet.
proposedByAssistant: Proposed by the assistant. Nothing runs until you press the button.

hint.sealed: Sealed: rewritten into a compressed column store. Late writes still land.
hint.tiered: Tiered: its column store lives in S3; reads fetch what they need.
hint.default: Default: catches rows outside every range. They are moved out, not kept here.
hint.foreign: Not made by SnoutTime, so it is left alone.
hint.spread: Split by the space key into hash partitions.
